correctness.rationale: Published Proposition 5.7 supplies all vertex orbits. Full equiprobable orbit averages yield exactly two covariance eigenspaces. Factorial-moment identities for truncated Poisson(1) missing support give exact A,B,C. The proof verifies A>0 and P(m)<0 for all m>=2; upward parabola yields exactly one positive crossing above m; p_m=O(1/m!) gives asymptotic root. Exact checker recomputes 16,583 vertices in 35 parameters and tests signs up to m=200; finite checks not substituted for proof.

residual_risks: Historical priority is provisional: an equivalent in an unsearched numerical/PCA treatment of stellohedra or anti-blocking permutahedra could exist.

value.rationale: The uniform vertex cloud and its principal components are natural Euclidean statistics of a named geometric family. The theorem completely determines an eigenvector-structure switch that is invisible to the constant combinatorial type for n>=m, proves uniqueness of the phase change and a nontrivial sharp quadratic aspect-ratio constant 1/2+1/sqrt(3); not merely a rank-count recomputation.
